summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 6/6 logical features verified — agentic 3-actions (manually via curl with fresh location), emotional/no-actions, off-topic redirect, complete_priority, voice-empty 400, nutrition POST/GET. Pytest shows 4/6 passing because Meera dedups across the *global* chat history (session_id is not used to filter prior messages), so re-running similar messages produces 0 actions. Frontend: all checks pass — Meera FAB with lily glyph (NO avatar), 'Meera · you, five years from now' header, mic/input/send testIDs, action chips render with 'Added project: Adyar 4BHK Office Space (warm lead)', no endearments, Planner shows 5-category legend, coloured dots per date, and Mon–Fri auto-gym card ('Gym · Push Chest+Tri', 'Auto · weekday'). All previous flows still working.

minor.issue: session_id is accepted but NOT used to filter chat history in _meera_reply (line 565: db.chat_messages.find({}) loads all messages regardless of session). Result: Meera sees prior test sessions and refuses to re-act on similar inputs, replying 'already logged' / 'you just said this'. Functionality is correct on a fresh DB but test reproducibility and multi-user isolation are broken.

issues: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow (cosmetic, RN web)

action_items: Fix chat history isolation in _meera_reply (server.py L565): change `db.chat_messages.find({}, ...)` to `db.chat_messages.find({'session_id': session_id}, ...)` AND persist session_id on ChatMessage inserts in /api/meera/chat and /api/meera/voice. Without this, the agentic system can't be tested deterministically and any second user shares Meera's memory.
Optional: add /api/meera/clear or /api/meera/reset endpoint to wipe history per session for test cleanup.

rca_of_issue:
RCA — Meera over-deduplicates across sessions:
File: /app/backend/server.py, function _meera_reply (≈ L554-586).
Line 565: `history = await db.chat_messages.find({}, {"_id": 0}).sort("created_at", 1).to_list(40)` — pulls ALL messages from every session into the LLM prompt as 'recent exchange'. Combined with Claude's strong tone rule ('Sandhya, you just said this'), any repeat-looking input emits zero actions.
Reproduction: POST /api/meera/chat twice with the same message body and any session_id → second call returns actions:[].
Fix: (a) add `session_id` field to ChatMessage model, (b) set it on inserts in meera_chat and meera_voice, (c) filter history by `{'session_id': session_id}` in _meera_reply. Frontend already passes a session_id in the voice path; chat path defaults to 'meera-default' which is fine.
